accountBoundary.basis: Account discovery returned one child and one guardian record. The guardian record's user_id matches the signed-in user and its kindergarten_id matches that child's institution; child_access_view is enabled. No explicit child-to-guardian join or ownership guarantee is claimed.
accountBoundary.identifierHandling: Use only the already account-discovered institution and that one child. Do not include identifier values in this tracked plan, enumerate child records, or expose any other child's data.
accountBoundary.authorityCaveat: The UI's MyChild branch establishes the intended parent-client route, not universal server authorization semantics. The bounded account context is the reason this one child-scoped feed request is eligible.

reasons: The exact parent UI path is MyChildStack -> screen label Child diary. MyChildStack constructs this screen with the route's childId and employeeView=false (HASM #44019, lines 1795664-1795763).

The child diary screen reads route.params.childId and parent-side MyChild state, then supplies a fetch callback (HASM #44110, lines 1799541-1799597). The parent callback invokes getGuardianFeed with the first page and the non-employee branch (HASM #44115, lines 1799677-1799698).

For page 1 the thunk constructs a date parameter from its default date formatter using YYYY-MM-DD and calls the guardian-feed service (HASM #25515, lines 1000422-1000465). Page is client-side action state, not a query parameter.

The service issues Axios GET to the child-scoped guardian-feed path with config.params (HASM #25632, lines 1003318-1003338), then returns response.data through #25633. The success callback #25516 only forwards that data in a local Redux dispatch and keeps page bookkeeping separate (lines 1000474-1000503).

The scoped source review of the GET, success callback, focus/resume handlers, list callbacks, and rendered entry component found no explicit seen/read/write service call. Focus/resume, pull-to-refresh, content-size fill, and end-reached handlers can cause additional feed GETs; this plan limits validation to one first-page request and does not ask to exercise those triggers.

The controlling session's account observation is limited to one discovered child, an account-matching guardian record in that institution, and child_access_view enabled. No explicit child-to-guardian ownership relation is inferred, and no other-child lookup is needed or permitted.

queryTemplate.date: <the app's current-day date string, formatted YYYY-MM-DD>

operations.page: First page (page=1 in client action state; not sent as a query parameter).
operations.requestBudget: One request only. Do not launch the full screen as the transport if it may trigger automatic focus/content-size fetches. Do not invoke refresh, pagination, resume, retries, or any other endpoint as part of this validation.
operations.responseHandling: Keep the raw response private. Publish only redacted field names/shapes/types for the authorized child. If the response includes any data for a child other than the one already account-discovered, do not copy, print, or publish that data; stop and report only that the boundary check failed.
